headline: Fed decision Wednesday plus Microsoft, Alphabet and Amazon earnings and Thursday's GDP/core PCE headline a loaded week, with the 10-year near 5% and Brent above $110 on Iran/Houthi risks.
rates: The 10-year Treasury yield is hovering around the 5% mark after September's Fed hike, with markets pricing roughly a 75-80% chance of another hike by December.
fed: The FOMC is expected to hold at 3.75-4.00% on Wednesday Oct 28 (statement 2:00 PM, Chair Warsh press conference 2:30 PM ET), with the focus on his tone on a December hike; Daly and Musalem speak Friday.
oil: Brent is about $114.5 and WTI about $101 on Monday, down roughly 2% on hopes for US-Iran de-escalation via Qatari mediation, but Houthi attacks on Saudi oil facilities and Hormuz/Bab el-Mandeb disruptions keep supply risk high.
geo: US-Iran tensions (possible resumption of strikes) and Houthi attacks on Saudi energy infrastructure are the active shocks moving oil.
